52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.

explanation.problem: 每次排序请求都重新编码用户很长的行为历史太贵，想在有限算力和延迟内既用上长历史又保留候选相关的打分能力。
explanation.method: 先用一个因果Transformer把用户历史压成少量与候选无关的摘要token，离线算好缓存复用；线上只对最近若干条原始事件做一次编码，所有候选共享；候选广告经编码后作为查询，对摘要token和近期状态做交叉注意力得到点击预测；训练时同时用真实点击和更大教师模型（用未压缩全历史）的点击logit做蒸馏，让压缩器学会保留有用信息。
explanation.application: 推测：电商精排可把用户长期行为离线压缩成少量token缓存，线上只编码最近行为并对候选做交叉注意力，同时用全历史大模型蒸馏小模型，以在延迟预算内扩展历史长度。
explanation.caveat: 线上收益来自整体方案，未单独验证压缩器、蒸馏、平滑等各模块的贡献；离线仅单一内部数据集，且机构与数据集归属原文未说明。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: X-split Argus：学习可复用的历史Token以实现高效CTR预测
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出X-split ARGUS：历史压缩器离线把用户长行为序列编码为K个与候选无关的可复用历史token，在线排序器通过交叉注意力结合这些token与最近M个事件的表示对候选广告打分，压缩器与排序器端到端联合训练，并用处理未压缩历史的更大教师模型做点击logit蒸馏。离线NE相对Context-aware ARGUS基线降低0.81%（保留教师改进的71.6%），线上A/B（7天、各组6%流量）ACV提升4.65%、点击数提升2.96%，但线上推理需多用15%同型号GPU。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做精排长序列建模与在线成本权衡的工程师有直接参考价值：给出“离线可复用历史token+在线近期行为+教师蒸馏”的完整工业方案及线上A/B证据，但需注意收益来自整体方案而非单模块，且机构与数据集归属原文未说明。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B为7天、实验组与对照组各占该广告面6%流量，相对生产基线ACV提升4.65%、点击数提升2.96%，且需多用15%同型号在线GPU。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Regularizing Treatment Leakage for LLM-based Uplift Estimation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide semantic features for uplift estimation, but treatment-revealing text can induce prediction shortcuts that do not transfer to deployment. We propose LLM-based Uplift Leakage Regularization (LULR) to address this risk. With the LLM encoder frozen, LULR penalizes dependence between the causal head's trainable shared representation and treatment while retaining separate outcome heads. The penalty uses a variational approximation to the contrastive log-ratio upper bound (CLUB) of mutual information, targeting treatment dependence rather than generic parameter shrinkage. Controlled proxy experiments provide exploratory evidence of improved ranking scores under injected treatment information relative to no regularization and the tested weight-decay setting. Structured-only benchmarks show modest, dataset-dependent effects. On an industrial pricing randomized controlled trial, mean offline lift@0.3 is 0.258 for LULR, compared with 0.106 for the same-backbone baseline. A separate one-week online A/B test of the complete deployed pricing policy records 5.45% higher sales volume and 1.91% higher gross merchandise value than the control arm. These short-term policy-level gains do not isolate the regularizer's effect.

explanation.problem: 商品文本里可能混入了折扣决策之后才产生的信息（如“清仓”），模型会靠这些线索走捷径，而不是学习真正决定用户是否响应干预的需求语义。
explanation.method: 先用冻结的LLM把商品文本编码，再与结构化特征融合，送入共享表示和两个分别对应处理组与对照组的输出头。训练时额外加一个轻量分类器，用对比式互信息上界估计共享表示中还残留多少处理信息，并惩罚这部分依赖；分类器先拟合、主网络再最小化，与事实损失和倾向损失联合优化。输出仍是两组预测之差，用于排序谁更该被干预。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可在精排增益/价值模型中，对由商品标题、文案等冻结文本编码得到的共享表示加同类处理依赖惩罚，并用注入伪泄漏的离线实验先验证方向，再以独立A/B隔离该模块。
explanation.caveat: 受控实验用的是标量代理而非真实语义泄漏，工业离线差异不显著，线上A/B评估的是完整定价策略、无法归因于正则项。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 面向LLM增益估计的治疗泄漏正则化
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 针对冻结LLM编码的商品文本可能携带干预信息、导致增益模型走捷径的问题，作者在DragonNet式因果头中，对可训练共享表示与处理变量之间的互信息施加CLUB上界惩罚（LULR）。在注入代理特征的受控实验中，该惩罚使排序分数相对无正则和权重衰减有所提升；工业离线lift@0.3从0.106升至0.258，但差异不显著、策略价值几乎持平；一周线上A/B显示整体定价策略销量+5.45%、GMV+1.91%，但未单独隔离正则项贡献。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做精排价值建模和因果增益的工程师有直接参考价值：它给出一个可插拔的表示-处理依赖惩罚，并诚实区分代理实验、离线不显著结果与未归因的线上策略收益；但语义泄漏是否被真正去除、正则项是否带来线上增益均未被验证。

evidence.finding: 工业离线lift@0.3均值从0.106升至0.258，但5个种子中1个为负、差异不显著，估计策略价值几乎持平（7.10对7.15），说明离线排序提升未确立决策价值改善。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Lost in the Funnel: Selection-Induced Miscalibration in Ranking and Decision Systems
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Modern ranking and decision systems combine components with divergent objectives, and scores calibrated at the model boundary are used as calibrated probabilities throughout the funnel, across filtering, reranking, business-rule enforcement, and auctions. Yet calibration is typically validated only where the score is produced, so its breakdown where the score is used is routinely overlooked. We ask when calibration survives this selection, how inherited error differs from selection effects, and what can fail for a perfectly calibrated score at a component boundary. We study these questions through a boundary-wise diagnostic framework of residual identities. We target rubric-judged relevance rather than presentation-dependent metrics such as CTR, so calibration is measurable at every funnel layer of interest. We first present an industry-wide case study that applies our diagnosis to settings where calibration deteriorates at decision time, tracing the degradation to selection rather than model error. This diagnosis motivates Funnel-Aware Recalibration (FAR): post-hoc, selection-policy-aware recalibration at the boundary where scores drive decisions. In a live two-region production A/B test, FAR cuts decision-time expected calibration error (ECE) by 60-80% and improves auction efficiency. We further adapt two public datasets to simulate industry settings, providing additional evidence for the mechanism. We plan to release the adapted datasets and their generation pipeline to support further research. Finally, we distill these findings into practical operating principles for calibrating multi-stage scoring systems.

explanation.problem: 模型输出时校准良好的分数，经过过滤、重排、竞价等层层筛选后，在真正做决策的地方可能已经系统性偏了。
explanation.method: 把每个筛选边界前后的带标签样本按分数分箱，用残差恒等式把幸存者偏差拆成三部分：上游带来的继承误差、各分数箱占比变化造成的构成偏移、以及箱内被筛选者结果系统性偏离箱均值造成的残差偏移。诊断显示偏差主要来自第三项后，就在分数进入下游决策的那个边界上，用该策略实际保留下来的样本重新拟合一个单调校准映射，模型和服务规则都不动，并定期重拟合。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可在粗排到精排、精排到重排/混排、以及业务规则过滤后的每个边界做同样诊断，用曝光前的人工或规则相关性标签在幸存者上重校准分数，再用于阈值和排序融合。
explanation.caveat: 线上证据仅来自微软广告一个平台的两地区A/B，标签是广告相关性判定而非点击或转化，公开数据部分为仿真重放而非真实线上验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 迷失在漏斗中：排序与决策系统中的选择诱导校准偏差
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 论文提出按边界分解残差的诊断框架，把幸存者偏差拆成继承误差、构成偏移和残差偏移，并据此在分数真正被使用的边界上做选择策略感知的事后重校准（FAR）。线上两地区A/B中，决策时ECE从784/809bp降到314/234bp（降60–71%），曝光层降63/80%，广告覆盖下降3.1/9.2%、CTR升1.0/2.0%、RPM无显著变化；两个公开数据集的重放仅提供机制层面的仿真证据。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做精排价值建模和漏斗多阶段打分的工程师，它给出可落地的“在决策边界而非模型输出处校准”诊断与修正方法，并有线上A/B支撑；但线上只验证了广告相关性标签与拍卖场景，迁移到电商推荐需自行验证。

evidence.finding: 线上两地区A/B显示FAR把决策时ECE降低60–71%，同时广告覆盖下降、CTR上升、RPM无显著变化，属于线上对照实验证据。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic.

explanation.problem: 两个推荐策略差异很小、又经常推荐相同物品时，常规A/B测试需要大量流量才能判断哪个更好。
explanation.method: 先假设一个预测奖励的基准模型（控制变量），把每个动作的采样概率设成与两策略概率差乘以剩余奖励不确定度成正比，这个比例有闭式解；再用历史日志只优化基准模型本身，让整体估计方差最小，并加少量均匀采样兜底；最后用冻结的采样策略收集新数据，按概率差加权估计两策略效果之差。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可把候选重排策略与线上策略的概率差作为分配依据，把实验流量集中到两策略分歧大的物品上，并用历史点击日志拟合基准模型；需先确认线上系统能按请求逐动作设定采样概率。
explanation.caveat: 全部结论来自合成仿真，没有真实线上A/B或离线真实日志验证，且标准误未计入历史模型的不确定性。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 方差最优的反事实策略设计：面向样本高效的在线A/B测试
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 论文把两个随机策略之间的A/B测试写成成对离策略估计，推导出给定控制变量下方差最优的按上下文、按动作的日志策略闭式解，再联合优化标量或模型型控制变量。在合成仿真中（25/50/75个动作、1万/3万历史日志、1000至1万评估样本、每设置500次重复），其MSE在所有设置下低于平衡A/B和优化流量混合基线，模型型设计达到平衡A/B同等MSE只需39%至51%的评估流量；但全部证据来自仿真，没有真实线上A/B。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为推荐/搜索A/B测试提供可落地的动作级流量分配思路，能显著降低检测小策略差异所需流量；但只有合成仿真证据，且日志策略需在实验前冻结，迁移到真实系统需自行验证。

evidence.finding: 仿真结果显示模型型设计在1万评估样本时统计功效约为平衡A/B的1.5至2.1倍，错误选择更差策略的比例降低42%至63%，但均为合成环境结果。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Modern recommendation systems face substantial memory pressure, largely from the sparse embedding layer that maps high-cardinality categorical features into dense vectors. In-training embedding pruning (ITEP) removes less important embedding rows during training, yielding end-to-end memory savings but sometimes degrading accuracy because per-table pruning ratios are set by size-based heuristics. We use feature importance (FI) to guide these ratios (FI-ITEP), assigning higher pruning to tables tied to less important features. Across three large-scale recommendation models, FI-ITEP achieves 20--40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy relative to percentile-based ITEP. Because the feature-importance signal requires minimal resources to compute, these memory savings translate into concrete systems benefits: the same models train on fewer GPU trainers (e.g., 112 to 80) with higher per-GPU throughput, saving 1,000+ GPU-hours per model launch. We reproduce these trends on the open-source DLRM (Criteo 1TB) and quantify the end-to-end training-time and GPU-cost tradeoff---including the burden of computing FI---offering practical guidance for embedding pruning in real-world systems.

explanation.problem: 大规模推荐模型的稀疏嵌入表太占显存，现有按表大小决定剪枝力度的做法没有考虑特征本身对效果的重要性。
explanation.method: 先在小批量数据上对每个特征做打乱或Shapley采样，观察模型损失变化得到重要性分数；再按分数高低为每张嵌入表分配剪枝比例，越不重要的表剪得越多；训练中沿用原有机制把低重要ID哈希到共享行；最后在多个工业模型和开源数据上对比内存节省与NE。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可把该重要性信号用于稀疏特征表的分级剪枝与训练资源规划，先离线验证NE与内存权衡再考虑上线。
explanation.caveat: 主要证据为离线NE与训练资源对比，缺少线上A/B和线上服务指标验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 面向大规模推荐模型的智能嵌入剪枝
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 用置换/Shapley采样得到的特征重要性为每张稀疏嵌入表设定训练中剪枝比例（FI-ITEP），在三个工业级DLRM上相比按表大小分档的百分位基线取得20–40%总内存节省且评估NE持平或更优，并在开源DLRM+Criteo 1TB上复现趋势；线上收益仅体现为训练侧GPU数量与吞吐的仿真/配置对比，未做线上A/B。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做大规模稀疏嵌入训练与系统成本的推荐工程师有直接参考价值：给出可落地的按特征重要性分配剪枝比例方案及FI计算开销与漂移证据，但收益限于训练内存/GPU成本，未验证线上服务指标。

evidence.finding: 该页给出开源DLRM+Criteo 1TB的离线复现实验，FI-ITEP在相同内存削减下AUROC持平或更优，但仅为离线评估。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. Both act on shared SKU representations during training. This separates catalog relatedness from individual preference supervision and leaves the predictive serving path intact. PEETS achieves 78.20\% AUC, exceeding TWIN V2 by 0.90 percentage points and the matched base model by 1.15 points. In a 14-day online evaluation, gross auxiliary GMV per exposed user-day improves by 8.20\% over Policies, 3.06\% over Base, and 0.84\% over TWIN V2, with all three user-bootstrap 95\% intervals above zero. Bundling rate is 0.51 points below Policies. The cancellation interval's upper limit exceeds the prespecified margin. PEETS adds no auxiliary-loss computation to serving and records 42.1~ms p95 latency, compared with 42.0~ms for Base.

explanation.problem: 同一类辅助产品下不同SKU价格和保障范围差异大，用户拒绝某个报价不等于不喜欢整类产品，模型需要区分“目录相关”和“个人偏好”。
explanation.method: 先把SKU按品类和价格分位挂到一棵树上，每个节点有可训练嵌入。训练时做两类对比：同类同祖先的SKU互为正样本、跨类为负样本；对用户显式拒绝的SKU，用同层其他桶作参照，把被拒桶的统计量作为平移量加到比较双方上。两个辅助损失只更新共享SKU嵌入，线上仍用原来的点击和购买双头打分。
explanation.application: 推测可迁移到电商搭售、加购推荐和保险等辅助品精排：用类目-价格树构造对比正负样本，并把“删除/替换”等显式拒绝日志作为条件信号；需先确认自身日志有可区分的拒绝事件和稳定的类目价格层级。
explanation.caveat: 线上收益来自整体模型对比，未单独验证层级树与拒绝条件各自的线上贡献；取消率非劣性未通过，且数据仅来自单一旅行场景。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: PEETS：面向辅助产品搭售的偏好感知嵌入与显式树结构
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出训练期框架PEETS，用显式SKU层级树构造祖先条件对比损失和基于用户显式拒绝事件的负对比损失，正则化共享SKU嵌入，不改变线上打分路径。离线AUC 78.20%，比TWIN V2高0.90个百分点、比同骨干Base高1.15个百分点；14天线上实验每曝光用户日辅助GMV比Policies高8.20%、比Base高3.06%、比TWIN V2高0.84%，但搭售率低于Policies，且取消率非劣性检验未通过。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做精排价值建模和表征学习的推荐工程师有直接参考价值：给出可复现的层级+拒绝事件对比正则方案、同骨干消融和线上用户级bootstrap证据；但需注意取消率护栏未达标、层级与权重需按业务调参。

evidence.finding: 该页报告14天用户级随机线上实验：PEETS每曝光用户日GMV比Policies高8.20%、比Base高3.06%、比TWIN V2高0.84%，三个用户bootstrap区间均不含零，但取消率区间上限超过预设边际。

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: CARE: Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding with Listwise Reconstruction for Retrieval-Oriented Semantic IDs
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with the generation of a document's semantic ID (SID), so the SID tokenizer bounds what the retriever can recall. Common SID constructions (residual k-means, RQ-VAE, finite scalar quantization, capacity balancing) optimize criteria defined on document embeddings alone and do not control whether a query can still find its relevant documents after quantization. We propose two retrieval-oriented SID tokenizers. CARE-SID (Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding for Semantic IDs) quantizes in a retrieval-aligned space: a zero-initialized residual alignment network is trained with a query-document contrastive loss before quantization, an anchor loss and a reconstruction target fixed to the original embedding prevent drift and collapse, and reference-vector rating residual quantization assigns the codes. CARE-LR (CARE with Listwise Reconstruction) then distills, for each training query, the similarity distribution that the original embeddings induce over a candidate list into the SID reconstructions, through a function-preserving layer-resolved head. Both keep a document-only encoding interface. We judge SIDs without training a generator, by row-budget recall in a bucketing view (the partition) and a reconstruction view (the SID with its reconstruction). In offline evaluation on industrial video search data, both tokenizers achieve higher reconstruction-view recall than residual k-means, and CARE-LR improves further on CARE-SID, mainly through the listwise distillation. A comparison of two document embeddings shows that contrastive alignment helps most when the embedding has not been trained on search data, and that the embedding affects SID recall far more than the quantizer. CARE-SID is deployed in the generative retrieval stage of an industrial video search system.

explanation.problem: 生成式检索靠生成文档的语义ID来找回内容，但现有ID量化方法只关心文档自身能否被还原，不关心量化后查询还能不能把相关文档排到前面。
explanation.method: 先按残差k-means和R3-VAE分阶段热启动码本；再在量化器前加一个输出层初始为零的残差对齐网络，用查询-文档对比损失把查询和相关文档拉近，同时用锚定损失和以原始嵌入为目标的重建损失防止空间漂移或坍缩；最后在CARE-SID基础上，对每个训练查询把原始嵌入在候选列表上的相似度分布蒸馏到SID重建分布，并用逐层重建头保持起始函数不变。文档始终只由自身嵌入编码，查询只参与训练。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可把该思路用于生成式召回的商品语义ID构建，在已有召回嵌入上冻结主干、加残差对齐并用查询-商品对比与列表蒸馏优化ID；同时可借用其行预算召回协议在训练生成器前快速筛选ID方案。
explanation.caveat: 证据限于单一工业视频搜索数据的离线SID级指标，CARE-LR仅小规模试点，端到端生成式检索收益未验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: CARE：面向检索的语义ID的对比锚定残差编码与列表级重建
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 针对生成式检索中语义ID（SID）量化器只优化文档侧目标、不控制查询-文档检索损失的问题，提出CARE-SID（在量化前用零初始化残差对齐网络做查询-文档对比学习，并用锚定损失和固定重建目标防止漂移）与CARE-LR（把原始嵌入对候选列表的相似度分布蒸馏进SID重建）。在工业视频搜索离线数据上，重建视图Recall@10从RQ-KMeans的62.75%提升到CARE-SID的65.23%、CARE-LR的66.09%（配对95% CI [+2.30,+4.36]），增益主要来自列表级蒸馏；但全部为SID级离线指标，CARE-LR仅小规模试点，端到端GR结果未给出。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做生成式检索/语义ID的推荐工程师有直接参考价值：给出可增量编码的文档侧SID量化器设计、无需训练生成器的SID级评测协议，以及“嵌入质量比量化器更决定召回”的实证；但需注意其收益是重建视图离线指标、CARE-LR未大规模验证、且重建视图用到不属于整数SID的连续系数。

evidence.finding: 该页给出主结果表：CARE-SID与CARE-LR在重建视图Recall@10上高于RQ-KMeans，CARE-LR相对RQ-KMeans的配对差为+3.34点且95%置信区间不含零，但均为离线SID级指标。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: IntentGR: Enhancing Intent for End-to-End Personalized Generative Retrieval in Search
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Personalized generative retrieval in search should jointly satisfy the user's immediate search intent and long-term preference. Recent end-to-end approaches, primarily explored in recommendation, unify item tokenization and sequence generation within a single model, allowing semantic identifiers (SIDs) to be optimized toward the downstream generation objective. However, these methods often treat the query merely as an input feature, without explicitly leveraging it to guide either identifier learning or sequence generation. This leaves intent guidance weak in both the tokenization and the generation stage, causing generated semantic identifiers to drift toward high-frequency token patterns rather than the current search intent. In this work, we find that incorporating additional query-related evidence into the framework of end-to-end generative retrieval is important. Based on this finding, we propose IntentGR, an intent-enhanced end-to-end framework that strengthens query semantics at four complementary stages of the retrieval pipeline. Query-Aware Semantic Behavior Representation (QBR) introduces query-level behavioral evidence as a new input signal; Query-Semantic Alignment (QSA), Long-Tail Query Enrichment (LQE), and Query-conditioned Attention Modulation (QAM) then serve as integration mechanisms at the optimization, training-distribution, and decoding stages to fully exploit this evidence. Experiments on the public AOL4PS benchmark and AE, a large-scale industrial e-commerce dataset, show that IntentGR improves Recall@10 by 8.11% and 11.96% over the strongest baseline, with strong gains on long-tail queries. These results suggest that enriched query-related input evidence, together with effective integration mechanisms, is beneficial for building intent-aware end-to-end generative search systems.

explanation.problem: 个性化搜索里，生成式检索模型容易忽略当前查询意图，生成的物品标识偏向高频模式，长尾查询尤其差。
explanation.method: 先把同一查询下其他用户的历史点击序列作为新输入，与用户自身历史一起编码；再用对比学习把查询表示与目标物品的重构表示对齐，让分词器和生成器共享查询语义目标；接着对低频查询重复采样并做查询改写，平衡训练分布；最后在解码时把查询向量融合进上下文各位置，强化查询对生成标识的引导。
explanation.application: 推测可把查询级协同点击序列作为精排/生成式重排的额外输入特征，并用查询-物品对比损失约束语义标识学习；长尾查询重采样与改写可迁移到搜索训练数据构造。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线数据集评测，无线上A/B或仿真，四模块增益主要来自消融累加，未单独验证各模块在真实流量下的独立贡献。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: IntentGR：面向搜索端到端个性化生成式检索的意图增强
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出IntentGR，在输入、优化、训练分布和解码四个阶段强化查询意图，联合优化RQ-VAE物品分词器与生成式检索器。在AOL4PS和AliExpress工业数据集上，Recall@10较最强基线ETEGRec-Q分别提升8.11%和11.96%，长尾查询增益更大；证据限于离线评测，无线上A/B。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做生成式重排/检索的工程师，它给出查询级行为序列、查询-物品对比对齐、长尾查询增强和解码注意力调制四个可拆解模块，但只有离线指标、无线上验证。

evidence.finding: 表2离线对比显示IntentGR在AOL4PS和AE上Recall@10分别为77.99%和34.36%，高于最强基线ETEGRec-Q的69.88%和22.40%，但仅为离线评测，无线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

explanation.problem: 智能搜索里LLM只看一小撮文档作答，传统按单文档相关性排序挑出的文档集合未必能让答案更好。
explanation.method: 先为每个查询自动生成由粗到细的评分标准，列出必须覆盖的加权要点和必须避免的缺陷；再用大模型按标准给文档打分，蒸馏成轻量标注器，为海量查询-文档对产出效用等级，用来训练召回双塔和排序模型；最后用同一标准给候选文档子集打分作为奖励，用强化学习训练选择器，并用组内最佳结果做蒸馏缓解奖励稀疏。
explanation.application: 推测可把评分标准思路迁移到电商精排与生成式重排：用大模型按商品属性要点蒸馏逐商品效用标签，再对最终展示集合做集合级奖励训练。
explanation.caveat: 线上证据仅为14天5%流量的GSB人工对比，未报告留存或成交等业务指标，各模块增益存在重叠。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 从相关性到效用：元宝搜索中的评分标准对齐
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出以查询级评分标准（加权正/负准则）作为统一监督信号，蒸馏出逐文档效用标签训练检索与排序，并用GRPO加最佳轨迹蒸馏训练集合选择器。线上A/B显示各组件独立增益，全链路答案质量GSB提升8.52%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做生成式重排与集合级效用建模的推荐工程师有直接参考价值，但线上仅报告GSB人工评测，缺少留存等业务指标。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B中三个组件各自独立加入生产基线均显著提升答案GSB，全链路净增益8.52%，但各组件增益之和9.16%高于净增益，说明收益存在重叠。

institutions: School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic.

explanation.problem: 两个推荐策略差别很小时，常规A/B测试要花大量流量才能测出效果。
explanation.method: 先假设一个记录策略，按上下文为每个动作指定采样概率，再用历史日志训练奖励预测作为控制变量；推导出给定控制变量时方差最小的采样概率，正比于两策略概率差乘以剩余奖励不确定性，于是只需优化控制变量；最后用该策略收集新数据并加权估计两策略期望奖励之差。
explanation.application: 推测可用于推荐精排新策略上线前的流量分配：按两策略打分差异和剩余不确定性给动作分配曝光，而非固定五五分流。
explanation.caveat: 全部结论来自合成仿真环境，无真实线上A/B或离线日志验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 方差最优的反事实策略设计：面向样本高效的在线A/B测试
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 该文把两个策略之间的A/B测试写成成对离策略估计，推导出在给定控制变量下方差最优的动作级记录策略闭式解，并用历史日志联合优化记录策略与控制变量。仿真A/B测试中，基于模型的方案在全部60个设置上MSE低于四个基线，达到均衡A/B同等MSE只需39%至51%的评估流量。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为精排/推荐A/B测试提供按动作分配流量的可落地降方差设计，但证据仅来自合成仿真，无真实线上验证。

evidence.finding: 仿真中基于模型的控制变量方案在1万次评估交互时把均衡A/B的统计功效提高1.5至2.1倍，错误选策略率降低42%至63%，但绝对功效仍低于0.40，且全部为合成环境。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: COTTI: Contrastive Training and Time-Aware Inference for Robust Industrial Recommendation under Promotional Drift
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Promotional events shift traffic composition, purchase behavior, and the scale of conversion probabilities on different time horizons. We present \textbf{COTTI} (\textbf{CO}ntrastive \textbf{T}raining and \textbf{T}ime-aware \textbf{I}nference), an industrial recommendation framework that separates historical representation learning from event-time score adjustment. Cross-Period Contrastive Alignment (CPC) regularizes paired histories of the same user with adaptive consistency weights. Active Re-weighting (RW) controls the influence of promotional examples through historical-interest distance. Adaptive Boundary Alignment (ABA) combines stochastic prediction variability with a temporal event kernel to adjust logits while keeping predictor parameters fixed. We analyze the weighted objective and bound ABA-induced probability and ranking changes. On Fliggy data, COTTI attains an offline AUC of 0.8127, compared with 0.8101 for TEN and 0.8123 for TEN with ABA. Cross-category analysis reveals improved discrimination alongside declines in paid-item recall for novel categories. End-to-end measurements give a p99 latency of 38.9\,ms and throughput of 14,700 requests/s; enabling ABA adds 2.2\,ms to p99. A ten-day online experiment against the serving HDR model yields relative gains of 3.14\% in conversion rate and 2.68\% in revenue per mille. Together, these results characterize the trade-off between aggregate prediction, novel-category discovery, and serving cost in promotional recommendation.

explanation.problem: 大促期间用户行为和转化率分布突变，平时训练的模型反应太慢，排序和转化率估计会失准。
explanation.method: 先用同一用户平时与促销期的两段历史做对比学习，让表示保持一定一致，并按两段差异自适应调弱对齐强度；再按促销样本与用户历史兴趣的距离给训练样本加权，离历史越远权重越低；最后在参数冻结的推理阶段，用已公布的活动时间核和预测头多次随机前向得到的方差，对转化logit做单向抬升校正。
explanation.application: 推测可把训练期历史一致性正则与推理期事件感知分数校正拆开落地，在电商大促精排中作为独立于主模型的校准层试验，并用新品类召回和延迟做约束。
explanation.caveat: 线上仅与HDR单基线对比十天，未报告置信区间、分流方式和聚合权重，全量上线轨迹无同期对照。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: COTTI：面向促销漂移下鲁棒工业推荐的对比训练与时间感知推理
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出COTTI框架，用跨周期对比对齐、按历史距离重加权促销样本、以及推理期基于事件时间核与预测方差的logit校正三部分应对促销期分布漂移。Fliggy离线AUC 0.8127略高于TEN的0.8101，但TEN加ABA后差距仅0.0004；十天线上A/B相对HDR提升CVR 3.14%、RPM 2.68%，同时新品类付费召回下降、p99延迟增加2.2ms。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 三组件分工清晰、消融与校准对照较完整，可借鉴其训练期正则与推理期分数校正分离的思路；但增益幅度小、线上仅对HDR单基线且无置信区间，新品类召回有损。

evidence.finding: 离线消融显示去掉CPC、RW、ABA后AUC分别降至0.8082、0.8051、0.8102，但均为点估计且未分离组件交互。

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Deep Cross-Division Network for Product-and-Ratio Feature Interactions in Industrial Ranking
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Learning effective feature interactions is essential for industrial recommender systems. DCN and DCNv2 efficiently automate polynomial feature crossing. However, their cross layers construct interactions using only non-negative integer powers of the input features, with the maximum degree controlled by network depth. Consequently, they cannot directly represent the reciprocal terms required for ratios, rates, and normalized counts unless such features are explicitly provided as inputs. We introduce DCDN, a Deep Cross-Division Network that augments a DCNv2-style cross layer with a division branch. DCDN jointly learns product, ratio, and mixed product-ratio interactions. We characterize the representable interactions as multivariate Laurent polynomials and show that a $K$-layer DCDN generates Laurent monomials of $\ell_1$-order up to $K+1$, with signed degree between $-K$ and $K+1$. We evaluate DCDN against a production-optimized neural-ranking baseline built around DCNv2 and supplied with manually engineered ratio features. Replacing the DCNv2 block with DCDN allowed us to eliminate the entire class of manually engineered ratio features from the model input, reducing the number of input features by $40.1\%$. DCDN is deployed in the production ranking stack of a major short-video service. In a live A/B test on this service, DCDN increased likes by $3.25\%$, shares by $16.26\%$, total view time (TVT) by $0.33\%$, and clicks to open fullscreen by $0.38\%$; all changes were statistically significant. The number of shown videos decreased slightly ($-0.24\%$). These results demonstrate that DCDN can improve user engagement while eliminating reliance on manually engineered ratio features. Our code is publicly released at https://github.com/rw404/DCDN.

explanation.problem: 人工构造的点击率、完播率这类比值特征又多又贵，能否让模型自己从分子分母学出比值关系。
explanation.method: 输入仍是原始计数、上游模型分数等基础特征，不再提供人工比值。在DCNv2交叉层旁并联一条分支，用输入的逐元素倒数（带下限截断防止除零爆炸）与当前表示相乘，再与原乘积分支和残差相加，堆叠后即可生成乘、除及混合的单项式。输出送入后续Hiformer与多任务塔，端到端训练排序模型。
explanation.application: 推测可把电商精排中人工构造的转化率、人均曝光、比值类统计特征从输入中移除，改由交叉层的除法分支重建，并用容量匹配的DCNv2作对照验证增益来源。
explanation.caveat: 线上A/B同时改了特征集与交叉块，端到端收益无法单独归因于除法分支。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 面向工业排序中乘积与比值特征交互的深度交叉除法网络
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 在DCNv2交叉层上增加以输入逐元素倒数为锚的除法分支，使单层即可表达乘积与比值交互，并给出Laurent单项式支撑的理论刻画。离线四个公开数据集上稳定优于DCNv2且延迟相近，线上短视频排序A/B中点赞+3.25%、分享+16.26%、总观看时长+0.33%，同时移除40.1%人工比值特征。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对精排特征工程有直接价值：用模型结构吸收人工比值特征，且有线上A/B与延迟证据；但收益是特征路径与交叉块联合改动，未单独归因。

evidence.finding: 线上两周A/B（CUPED校正、双侧t检验、p<0.01）显示点赞+3.25%、分享+16.26%、总观看时长+0.33%、全屏点击+0.38%、曝光-0.24%，但处理组同时移除比值特征并替换交叉块，属联合干预。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Beyond Relevance: An Empirical Study of Multimodal LLMs for Diversity-Aware Recommendation Reranking
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising rerankers for recommendation, yet most existing approaches rely on textual item descriptions and primarily focus on relevance. In visually oriented domains such as video streaming, item images provide complementary signals that may also inform recommendation diversity. This raises two questions: when does visual information improve recommendation quality, and can multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) enhance relevance and diversity simultaneously? We investigate these questions through a training-free, diversity-aware multimodal reranking framework that jointly incorporates item images, textual metadata, and user interaction histories. We conduct an empirical study across three public Amazon Review datasets and an industrial Amazon Prime Video dataset, using both open-source and proprietary MLLMs. Our results reveal substantial domain-dependent effects: adding visual information yields up to 121.9% relative improvement in NDCG@5 on Prime Video, while producing limited or inconsistent gains on product recommendation datasets. Furthermore, MLLM-based reranking improves both relevance and category-diversity-sensitive ranking quality over a sequential recommendation baseline, achieving up to 71.0% improvement in NDCG@5 and 14.1% in $α$-NDCG@5 on Prime Video. These findings highlight the conditional value of visual information and the potential of training-free MLLMs for relevance- and diversity-aware recommendation reranking.

explanation.problem: 想知道给推荐重排加入商品图片，究竟在什么场景下能同时提升相关性和多样性。
explanation.method: 把用户最近若干条交互的图片横向拼成一张长图，候选商品图片同样拼成一张，并按顺序配上编号标题，使图文一一对应。提示词中加入分析视觉风格、考虑兴趣随时间变化、平衡探索与利用、兼顾相关性与品类多样性四条准则，要求模型只输出候选编号的排序。模型全程不训练，直接对采样候选或召回列表重排，再用相关性指标和品类覆盖指标评估。
explanation.application: 推测可先在视频、封面图信息量大的场景做离线重排试验，用组合图提示替代逐图输入以控制成本，并以α-NDCG监控多样性副作用。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线小候选集实验，无线上A/B，且未单独消融多样性指令的贡献。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 超越相关性：多模态大语言模型用于多样性感知推荐重排的实证研究
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出免训练的多模态重排框架MMRerank，把用户历史与候选商品的图片拼成组合图、配标题和多样性指令交给预训练多模态大模型直接输出排序。在三个公开Amazon商品集与工业Prime Video集上，视频域加图相对纯文本NDCG@5最高提升121.9%，重排相对SASRec最高提升71.0% NDCG@5和14.1% α-NDCG@5，但商品域增益有限且因模型而异。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 给出多模态大模型做多样性重排的域依赖证据与成本数据，可借鉴其组合图提示与α-NDCG评估，但仅离线小候选集实验、无线上A/B。

evidence.finding: 该页表2给出Prime Video上的相对提升：加图相对纯文本NDCG@5提升121.9%（InternVL3）与9.6%（Sonnet），重排相对SASRec提升66.4%与71.0% NDCG@5、12.0%与14.1% α-NDCG@5，属离线相对指标而非线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an objective calibrated to match online impact, and careful context engineering. In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint. Its best model increases search volume by 0.23\% in an A/B test of large scale. Several improvements were architectural changes the team had never tried, drawn from the broader industry and literature, suggesting that MLE agents can explore regions of the design space that human intuition overlooks. We find that the design of the harness around the model matters: intuition suggests that a stronger underlying model is enough, but in our experience, the design of the loop around it is just as critical. More broadly, our work shows that autonomous agents can do real machine-learning engineering in industry-scale systems.

explanation.problem: 能否让LLM智能体在真实工业级排序系统上自主完成模型改进的提出、实现、训练与评估，并带来线上收益。
explanation.method: 智能体读取当前模型配置、历史实验和失败清单，先检索文献与代码提出架构想法，再为每个候选写一处连贯的代码改动，提交分布式训练，读取校准后的离线指标并与同轮方差探针比较，超过阈值才保留，拒绝项写入失败清单。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴其校准离线目标、方差探针阈值、失败清单与并行候选机制，用于精排模型迭代的自动化实验管理。
explanation.caveat: 仅单次campaign、目标与搜索预算同时变化，非受控消融，且线上仅一个A/B结果。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: MLE智能体：大规模推荐系统中的自主机器学习工程
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 构建人在环上的LLM智能体，自动提出、实现、训练并离线评估大规模搜索排序模型改动，单次campaign完成1097个候选实验、接受325个，最终模型在线A/B搜索会话量提升0.23%±0.15，但存在时延回退。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对精排价值建模与自动化实验闭环有直接借鉴，但仅单次campaign、离线在线口径与消融不完整，需谨慎迁移。

evidence.finding: 该页报告2.0 campaign离线累计加权NE改进-0.0224，并给出在线A/B搜索会话量+0.23%±0.15，同时注明时延护栏回退。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: LQ-Rec: Late Quantization for Sequential Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) for sequential recommendation compresses each item into a short semantic ID and trains an autoregressive decoder to generate next-item codes from a user history. While appealing for cold-start handling and storage, au- toregressive GR suffers a structural scaling limit: typically, longer semantic IDs reduce quantization error in principle but degrade ranking quality and quadratic memory usage against semantic ID length. We propose Late Quantization (LQ), a non-autoregressive paradigm that confines discretization to the output (item) side of the pipeline. The encoder and scoring rule operate in continuous space, while items are stored and matched as semantic IDs produced by an end-to-end-trained residual quantizer. This architectural shift permits an additive error decomposition and a pairwise ordering theorem that jointly bound the quantization- induced ranking drop, a structural guarantee absent in prior semantic-ID recommenders. Across four public benchmarks, the resulting recommender, LQ-Rec, delivers three capabilities simultaneously: ranking quality improves monotonically with the semantic-ID length and outperforms existing baselines; a single trained model supports anytime compression, tuning ranking quality against inference cost without retraining; and LQ-Rec shows superior generalization on a memorization/generalization partition.

explanation.problem: 生成式检索把物品先压成离散编码再让模型读这些编码，导致编码越长排序反而越差、显存和推理开销越大。
explanation.method: 先让序列模型在连续物品向量上正常预测用户向量，再用残差量化器把物品向量压成多级离散编码，打分时用用户向量与量化后物品向量做内积。训练分两步：先软到硬地联合训练编码器与码本，再冻结编码器、按不同前缀长度微调码本，使一个模型可在推理时截断编码长度。
explanation.application: 推测：电商召回/重排可把语义ID只用于物品侧存储与倒排匹配，用户侧保持连续向量，从而按成本在线截断编码长度；但需验证非线性打分与多路融合下的收益。
explanation.caveat: 全部证据来自四个公开数据集的离线留一法评测，无线上A/B或仿真，理论保证仅适用于内积打分。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: LQ-Rec：面向序列推荐的延迟量化
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出延迟量化框架：序列编码器与打分保持在连续空间，仅对物品侧做端到端训练的残差量化，从而得到可加误差分解与排序保持界；在四个公开基准上，排序质量随语义ID长度单调提升，单一模型支持推理时前缀截断，并在记忆/泛化划分上优于语义ID基线。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为生成式重排/语义ID检索提供“量化只放物品侧”的可分离设计，可迁移到大规模目录的召回与重排；但仅离线基准验证，无线上A/B，且理论依赖内积打分。

evidence.finding: 表IV显示单一M=16检查点按前缀截断后，Recall@10随长度单调不降，且在L=4/8/16多数格子超过对应长度的TIGER、RPG、VQ-Rec基线，属离线基准对比。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high- and low-signal samples. Extensive experiments on two post-click conversion prediction tasks demonstrate that HME-PFD consistently outperforms baseline methods. Our results show that leveraging privileged features for expert routing in the student model leads to improved model performance, even when privileged features are incomplete or sparse.

explanation.problem: 训练期才有的特权特征常常缺失或分布不均，导致蒸馏时各样本的教师信号质量参差，学生模型难以区别对待。
explanation.method: 教师用常规特征加特权特征训练并给出软标签；学生主干只吃常规特征，另设一个仅训练期使用的专家混合辅助蒸馏任务，由特权特征的可用性与取值决定每个样本进入哪个专家，最后把各专家的蒸馏损失加权合并成一个标量；服务时只保留主任务，不访问特权特征。
explanation.application: 推测可把特权特征（如点击后停留时长）的缺失模式作为门控信号，在精排蒸馏中为高信号样本分配更强监督，并对比硬规则与线性门控。
explanation.caveat: 仅两个工业CVR数据集的离线NE对比，无线上A/B，增益幅度很小且未单独验证路由模块的端到端贡献。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 异构专家混合特权特征蒸馏
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出HME-PFD，用特权特征（仅训练期可见）驱动学生模型MoE路由，以应对特权特征稀疏异构；在两个工业CVR数据集上离线NE相对Plain基线降低0.06%–0.42%，但无线上A/B。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为特权特征缺失下的蒸馏路由提供可借鉴设计，但仅离线NE、增益极小且无线上验证。

evidence.finding: 该页表1给出两个CVR数据集上各路由方式的离线NE相对Plain基线的差值，属离线评估而非线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: LazUnirec: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking in Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically divide retrieval and ranking into two separate cascaded stages, leading to inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant encoding of user sequences, and a waste of computational resources. Previous efforts have investigated using Transformers to model both retrieval and ranking simultaneously. However, these studies still face two major limitations: (1) Since retrieval and ranking share a single Transformer backbone, the gradient conflict arises when the gradient directions of the two tasks are inconsistent. (2) When gradient conflict occurs, the model cannot determine a reliable direction for gradient updates. To this end, we propose a Unified Retrieval and Ranking approach for Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation, termed as LazUnirec. Specifically, we construct task-shared and task-private parameters on the Transformer backbone to mitigate the gradient conflict. Wherein, for the attention components, we propose LoRA-modulated attention, enabling retrieval and ranking to share attention parameters while preserving task-private parameters. For the feed-forward networks (FFN), we present task-adaptive sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to mitigate gradient conflict by constructing task-shared and task-private experts. Moreover, we propose an uncertainty estimation that evaluates the gradient reliability of the retrieval and ranking, thereby guiding the model toward a more reliable gradient update direction when gradient conflict occurs. In addition, knowledge distillation from ranking to retrieval further enables cross-task knowledge transfer. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of LazUnirec. LazUnirec has been deployed in online multi-scenario industrial recommendation system and currently delivers significant gains for the platform.

explanation.problem: 召回和排序各用一套模型重复编码同一段用户行为，目标不一致还浪费算力，想合成一个模型又互相拖累。
explanation.method: 把用户行为序列、场景触发标记、多个召回查询和候选物品拼成一条序列输入共享Transformer；注意力层给召回和排序各加一组低秩私有参数，前馈层给每个任务配私有专家并稀疏调用共享专家；再按梯度方向的历史稳定性给两个任务的损失加权，并用排序输出蒸馏召回。输出同时给出召回打分和点击/转化预估。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴其任务私有低秩参数加共享专家的做法，在电商召回排序一体化中控制梯度冲突，并用请求级候选列表做排序到召回的蒸馏。
explanation.caveat: 线上A/B是整体替换原召回与排序模型的结果，各模块贡献仅有离线消融，且仅一个平台一周10%流量。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: LazUnirec：在多场景工业推荐中统一召回与排序
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 用一个Transformer主干统一多场景召回与排序，通过LoRA调制注意力、任务自适应稀疏MoE、梯度不确定性加权和排序到召回的蒸馏缓解梯度冲突。离线三场景AUC/HR均优于UniPinRec、UniR2、UniSGR、OneTrans-V2，线上10%流量一周A/B中免触发场景GMV+4.01%、触发场景+3.06%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 统一召回排序主干与梯度冲突缓解对精排/召回一体化有直接参考价值，但线上收益为整体替换两阶段模型所得，未单独归因各模块。

evidence.finding: 离线三场景中LazUnirec在排序AUC/GAUC和召回HR@100/500/1000上均优于Transformer、UniPinRec、UniR2、UniSGR、OneTrans-V2，属单一平台离线对比。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Speculative Decoding for Semantic-ID-Based Generative Recommendations
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Generative recommender systems with Semantic IDs (SIDs) represent each item as a short sequence of $L$ discrete tokens and use a sequence model to predict the next item's tokens from a user's history. Industry-scale deployments typically use these models to retrieve multiple candidates per request with constrained beam search. However, this incurs a fixed cost of $L$ sequential model calls per request, and accuracy degrades as the SID generator becomes less sharp, without a guarantee on how close the output is to the exact top-$K$. Production systems therefore cannot detect degraded retrieval for individual requests. We propose SIDECAR, which uses approximate draft candidates and a tree-attention pass to score the entire draft in a single model call, memory permitting. This pass bounds the probability of every unexplored SID prefix and certifies the exact top-$K$ if the draft contains them. Otherwise, a branch-and-bound fallback expands only the parts of the trie that can still change the output, reaching certification within at most $L$ calls for any draft. Moreover, under a budget of $M$ tokens per call and $Y$ calls, which for $Y = L$ matches the resources of a beam search of width $M$, SIDECAR announces a factor $1 + δ$ within which its list will be exact at every rank. Depending on model sharpness, SIDECAR returns the exact top-$K$ using a fraction of beam search's calls or memory. Even when the budget is too small to recover the exact top-$K$, SIDECAR, unlike beam search, reports the announced factor, allowing the serving system to stop early once a quality target or latency limit is reached.

explanation.problem: 生成式召回用束搜索逐层解码语义ID，每请求固定跑L次串行模型调用，且无法判断返回的列表是否就是模型真正的top-K。
explanation.method: 输入是用户历史和一份近似草稿（如批任务存下的用户序列或协同过滤结果）。把草稿的语义ID插成候选树，用一次带树掩码的前向同时算出草稿及其兄弟节点的精确概率，并给出未展开前缀的概率上界；若已得分第K名不低于该上界，就证明列表即精确top-K。否则只展开可能改变结果的前缀，最多L轮必然精确；在内存和轮数预算下，第一轮后即公布列表与精确解的近似倍数。
explanation.application: 推测：可把线上已有的粗排或多路召回结果当作草稿，替换生成式召回的束搜索解码，用证书决定是否提前返回或升级预算，并按离线覆盖率挑选草稿来源。
explanation.caveat: 仅在Amazon Beauty单数据集上做离线分布重放，无线上A/B、真实延迟与大规模目录验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 面向基于语义ID的生成式推荐的推测解码
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出SIDECAR解码器：用近似草稿做一次树注意力打分，给出精确top-K的证书，证书不成立时只扩展仍可能改变结果的开放前缀，并在内存与轮数预算下提前公布近似因子。在Amazon Beauty上以离线重放验证：锐利模型下与束搜索列表一致但所需轮数不到一半，模型变平时束搜索需接近全目录宽度才精确，而SIDECAR所需内存低一个数量级以上。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做生成式召回/重排线上解码的工程师有直接价值：把束搜索的固定L次串行调用换成草稿加证书与预算内保证，但证据仅来自单数据集离线重放，无线上A/B与延迟实测。

evidence.finding: 实验为离线重放：对每个测试用户跑一次全目录树前向得到精确分布，各解码器在此分布上确定性重放，非线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by LLMs.To address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. PROSPER combines (i) a literal residual network that alleviates lexical expansion hallucination by reinforcing underweighted literal terms through a residual compensation mechanism; and (ii) a lexical focusing window that uses top-k selection for rapid early sparsification and effective training initialization. Extensive offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B tests demonstrate that PROSPER consistently improves over existing sparse retrievers, and provides revenue gains for industrial hybrid retrieval systems.

explanation.problem: 商品搜索的短查询和标题里品牌、型号等字面词很关键，但用大模型做稀疏检索时这些词权重被语义扩展淹没，还容易扩出无关词。
explanation.method: 先用大语言模型把查询和商品编码成词表维度上的稀疏权重；再用字面残差网络，以当前最大权重为参照，给查询和标题中原本出现的字面词补上可学习的加权，压住无关扩展；训练早期用词法聚焦窗口只保留权重最高的若干词，加快稀疏化，之后交给稀疏正则继续调整；最后用对比排序损失训练，输出可倒排检索的稀疏向量。
explanation.application: 推测可把字面残差补偿思路迁移到电商稀疏召回通道，用于保护品牌、型号等精确匹配信号；上线前需在自有数据上单独做模块消融和分通道归因。
explanation.caveat: 线上A/B只报告混合召回系统的整体业务指标，未单独验证各模块贡献，且仅覆盖约1%流量。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: PROSPER：用大语言模型作为首阶段商品搜索的稀疏检索器
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 用大语言模型做稀疏检索，并加入字面残差网络和词法聚焦窗口，以保留品牌、型号等字面词。离线在Multi-CPR电商集上Hit@1000达93.9%，线上1%流量A/B测试中直接引导净GMV提升1.60%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做电商首阶段召回和稀疏检索的工程师有直接参考价值，但线上收益来自混合召回通道整体，未单独归因于各模块。

evidence.finding: 离线主实验表明PROSPER在Multi-CPR电商集上Hit@1000为93.9%，高于BM25Qwen的83.7%、SPLADE-v2的89.6%和SPQwen-echoembedding的92.4%，但Hit@1仍低于BGE-large-zh-v1.5。

institutions: State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Learning the Platform, Not the Learner: Sequencing Shortcuts in the Offline Evaluation of Educational Recommender Systems and LLM Rankers
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Educational recommenders are usually compared offline, by how well they predict the next activity in logs of tutoring systems, learning applications and MOOCs, where the next activity is largely decided by the platform: teachers assign problem sets, tutors draw problems until mastery, engines select questions. On eight public datasets from five platforms, we compare four structural predictors, which use nothing about the learner beyond the last activity, with ten personalised recommenders and with open-weight LLM rankers from 0.5 to 7 billion parameters, under two protocols. The structural predictors reach between 0.81 and 1.00 of the best accuracy of any method (median 0.95), mostly through population transitions rather than the course order; the best personalised recommender is significantly better on five datasets, by 0.007 to 0.102 NDCG@10, and on Eedi in three of four training runs. Every method is far less accurate on steps along transitions never seen in training and on steps chosen by learners. LLM rankers look competent with random negatives but are never much better than a word-matching baseline, and with negatives that are plausible under the course structure they stay close to random or well behind the transition heuristic, whatever their size. In a simulation with known learner needs, the structural share tracks the share of steps decided by the platform, and offline accuracy ranks an oracle of the learners' needs below imitators of the platform. Weighting test steps by how unlikely the structure makes them restores much of the link with usefulness and, on the real data, reveals a significant personalisation signal on seven of the eight datasets. We propose a syllabus-aware evaluation checklist and release a Python package that reports the lift of any recommender over the structure.

explanation.problem: 离线评估中，模型分数高可能只是学会了平台安排下一步的固定套路，而非真正理解用户。
explanation.method: 先定义只依赖上一步活动和全体用户统计的结构预测器（热度、课程顺序、同容器延续、群体转移频率），在相同测试样本上算出结构基线；再用个性化模型和LLM排序器与基线比较，得到提升量和结构占比；最后按是否见过该转移、是否离开容器、由平台还是学习者发起拆分结果，并用逆转移概率加权修正评估。
explanation.application: 推测：电商精排可把“上一物品转移频率+类目延续+热度”作为零训练基线，报告模型相对基线的提升，并按曝光来源（系统推荐/用户主动搜索）和是否跨类目拆分评估，避免把系统曝光策略误当个性化能力。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线观察性证据，无线上A/B或真实学习收益验证，LLM仅测到7B且部分仅100例。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 学到的是平台而非学习者：教育推荐系统与LLM排序器离线评估中的序列捷径
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 在8个教育数据集上，用只依赖上一步活动的结构预测器对比10个个性化推荐器和0.5B–7B开源LLM排序器，发现结构预测器已达最佳NDCG@10的0.81–1.00（中位0.95），个性化提升仅0.007–0.102；LLM在随机负样本下看似可用，但不如词匹配基线，在结构合理负样本下接近随机。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 提供“结构基线+提升量+结构占比”的评估框架和按步类型拆分的做法，可迁移到电商精排与生成式重排的离线评估；但证据限于教育日志的离线观察，无线上A/B。

evidence.finding: P1协议下结构预测器MC在8个数据集中的7个为最佳结构方法，结构占比0.81–1.00（中位0.95），最佳个性化方法仅在5个数据集上显著更优，提升0.007–0.102 NDCG@10。

institutions: École Nationale Supérieure d’Art et de Design (ENSAD)
Hassan II University of Casablanca, Morocco

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: MELODI: Similarity-Identity Decoupling for Lightweight Ranking
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: For latency-constrained candidate ranking, we propose a similarity-identity decoupling framework that separates target-history compatibility from target-only information. We study two orders for computing pooled similarity, similarity-then-pool and pool-then-similarity, and identify linearity of the similarity operator in its history argument, for each fixed target, as sufficient for their equivalence, justifying the cheaper pool-then-similarity form. We instantiate the framework as multi-head efficient lightweight operator for decoupling identity and similarity (MELODI), whose similarity branch combines target-conditioned multi-head history pooling with a single residual-free cross layer that is linear in its pooled-history input and whose identity branch is problem-dependent. On public benchmark datasets, MELODI matches or surpasses the evaluated target-aware and target-agnostic baselines. On two large-scale industrial datasets, its area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), normalised discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), and recall values are equal to or higher than those of the evaluated target-aware baselines. Processor measurements show lower latency than the evaluated candidate-conditioned baselines at large candidate counts, further reduced by request-local history reuse.

explanation.problem: 在候选多、时延紧的精排阶段，既要让每个候选按用户历史做个性化打分，又不想为每个候选重复编码整段历史。
explanation.method: 输入是用户历史序列和一批候选物品。先用共享投影和归一化处理，再让每个候选作为查询对历史做多头交叉注意力，得到按候选加权的历史汇总；随后用目标相关的门控专家把汇总历史与目标投影逐维相乘，得到显式相似性向量，另用一条只处理目标的分支保留目标自身信息，最后拼接打分。由于相似算子对历史是线性的，可以先汇总再算相似，从而每个请求只编码一次历史。
explanation.application: 推测：可在电商精排中把历史键值缓存为请求级共享张量，候选侧只做注意力打分与门控交叉，用于千级候选场景降时延；需自行验证与现有DIN类模型的线上收益。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线公开与私有日志数据评估，无线上A/B，时延仅在单一CPU机型测得。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: MELODI：面向轻量级排序的相似性—身份解耦
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出将用户—目标相似性与目标自身身份信号解耦的排序框架，并证明相似算子对历史线性时先池化后相似与先相似后池化等价，据此用多头交叉注意力加无残差门控交叉层实现MELODI；在两个公开数据集和两个工业数据集上离线指标不劣于或优于目标感知基线，且在1000候选时延低于候选条件基线。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为精排提供可复用历史、按请求共享计算的目标感知轻量结构，但仅有离线与单机时延证据，无线上A/B。

evidence.finding: 公开数据集三次种子平均下MELODI在全部指标上最高，但仅为离线采样负例评估，且部分对比为单次训练。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost. Experiments with SASRec demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving over 100% and 60% improvement in group-specific NDCG@20 for extreme and regular long-tail items, respectively, on our industrial dataset, and 40%, 25% for MovieLens-32M, while increasing their coverage without significant overall degradation.

explanation.problem: 推荐系统偏爱热门物品，长尾和冷启动物品因交互太少而学不好表示，需要在不明显拖累整体排序的前提下给它们补充训练信号。
explanation.method: 先按物品被交互次数把目录分成冷启动、极端长尾、常规长尾和热门四组；对目标组随机抽一部分用户，用文本嵌入按相似度挑出十个候选物品，让大模型从中选一个最符合该用户口味的物品；把这个合成交互插到用户序列倒数第二个位置，再用增强后的数据从头训练序列推荐模型；最后改变增强比例，观察组内排序质量和整体排序质量之间的取舍曲线。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴其按频次分组、组内候选池约束生成、以及以整体指标为护栏的调参框架，用于电商长尾商品和冷启商品的离线数据增强试验；但需先在自己的模型上验证整体指标不降。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线重训实验，无线上A/B，且多数配置下整体NDCG@20下降，跨组最优策略不可加。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 从头到尾：LLM增强的序列推荐与权衡优化
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 按交互频次把物品分为冷启动、极端长尾、常规长尾和热门四组，用LLM在组内候选池中为部分用户生成一条合成交互并插入序列，再重训SASRec，以组内NDCG@20和覆盖率为目标、整体NDCG@20下降为约束做权衡分析。在自有工业数据和MovieLens-32M上，极端长尾与常规长尾组的组内NDCG@20分别提升超过100%和60%（工业数据）、40%和25%（ML-32M），但整体NDCG@20在多数配置下下降，且各组最优策略不能简单叠加。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 对做长尾与冷启动增强的精排/召回工程师有参考价值，但证据限于离线SASRec重训实验，无线上A/B，且整体指标普遍受损。

evidence.finding: 该页表3显示在PRD的G2组、5%增强比例下，随机候选加LLM重排使整体NDCG@20下降4.03%、组内提升24.87%，而嵌入候选加LLM重排整体下降2.09%、组内提升48.28%，说明增益伴随整体指标代价。

institutions: Department of Computer Science, Carnegie Mellon University

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Multi-Modal Causal Disentanglement for Multi-Domain Sequential Audio Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Modern music platforms expose users to heterogeneous audio content domains such as songs, playlists, and podcasts. Multi-domain sequential recommendation (MDSR) seeks to exploit such cross-domain behavior, yet two obstacles persist in practice. First, joint optimization across heterogeneous domains is prone to negative transfer, with high-traffic domains dominating the shared parameter space and suppressing weaker domains. Second, conventional ID-based collaborative signals fail to bridge domains that are semantically related but exhibit little behavioral overlap. This paper presents CAMAR, a multi-modal causal disentanglement framework for multi-domain audio recommendation. From a causal perspective, user behavior is modeled as the joint outcome of a domain-invariant preference and domain-specific preferences. Guided by this view, CAMAR factorizes user representations into domain-invariant and domain-specific components and enforces domain adversarial invariance together with orthogonality, restricting cross-domain interaction to the invariant subspace and suppressing harmful transfer paths. To strengthen cross-domain semantic coupling, CAMAR derives trainable semantic-ID embeddings from pre-trained text, vision, and audio features through residual quantization, yielding an end-to-end multi-modal adaptation tailored to recommendation. A transfer network imputes user representations for inactive domains, mitigating cross-domain cold start. Experiments on both public and industrial datasets demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines. In online A/B tests on NetEase Cloud Music, one of China's largest music streaming platforms, CAMAR delivers consistent gains across all three domains in their main traffic scenarios, validating its effectiveness in multi-domain audio recommendation at scale.

explanation.problem: 多个内容域共享一套模型时，高流量域会压制低流量域，且缺少行为共现的用户难以跨域对齐。
explanation.method: 先用文本、图像、音频特征经残差量化得到跨域共享的语义编号，与各域ID融合后分别编码出每域用户表示；对无行为域用成对迁移网络补全。再把表示拆成域不变与域特有两部分，用正交约束分开、用域对抗去掉域身份信息，只让不变部分参与跨域注意力，最后门控融合打分。
explanation.application: 推测可把电商的搜索、推荐、直播等场景视为多域，用语义ID对齐无共现商品，用域对抗与正交约束保护低流量场景；迁移网络可补全新场景用户表示。
explanation.caveat: 线上A/B只测新增召回通道的整体增益，未单独验证解耦、语义ID、迁移网络各自的贡献。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 面向多域序列音频推荐的多模态因果解耦
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出CAMAR，把多域用户表示拆成域不变与域特有分量，用正交约束、域对抗和受限跨域注意力抑制负迁移，并用多模态语义ID与迁移网络补全冷启动域表示。离线两个数据集均优于九个基线，网易云音乐两周线上A/B中歌曲播放时长+1.0%、歌单点赞率+3.0%、播客播放时长+1.6%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 多域负迁移与冷启动补全思路可迁移到电商多场景推荐，但线上仅验证新增召回通道的整体收益，未单独归因各模块。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B为两周实验，实验组在原有分域召回管线基础上新增CAMAR召回通道，共享相同排序与重排模块，三个域指标均显著提升，但未拆分各模块贡献。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. After reinitializing the entire 13.6M-parameter interaction module randomly while retaining the surrounding trained model, searching 2,448 mixing and normalization parameters yields 9.8 points above production. Offline gains span the full funnel including dense retrieval, generative retrieval and ranking, with up to 1.37B learnable parameters and different edits for each architecture. Steering edits provide explicit control of model performance over segments like freshness and product. Weight coding requires no serving change and online A/B tests increase saves per user from the edited retrieval source by 8.4\% to 10.7\%, aligned with the target business objectives. Our results establish weight coding as a practical and useful tool for model development and and behavioral control in a real web-scale production system, with potential to extend to both pre-training and post-training stages across the funnel.

explanation.problem: 训练好的大模型想继续变好或按业务目标调行为，通常只能重训或微调，代价高、周期长。
explanation.method: 先让大语言模型智能体读模型结构和权重，提出并执行局部改动（缩放、重置、置零、插值、沿方向加偏置等）；用缓存中间结果的前向引擎快速评估，再用进化策略在选定张量上搜索数值；改动先在开发日筛选、跨日过滤，最后在留出日和生产评估器上验证，人工审核后上线。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可对精排/召回模型的归一化增益、共享偏置、专家分支强度做小规模直接编辑，用固定留出日与线上指标做验证，快速试出面向收藏、曝光结构等目标的调参方向。
explanation.caveat: 主要证据来自Pinterest内部模型与评估器，编辑跨模型不通用，离线增益到线上有衰减，且未与完整重训做同预算对照。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 权重编码：用LLM智能体直接编辑权重来演化网页级推荐模型
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出权重编码：由LLM智能体检查模型结构与权重、提出假设并直接改写选定参数，配合缓存前向评估引擎与进化策略搜索，在Pinterest图像搜索双塔检索模型上离线recall@10最高提升15.0个百分点，线上A/B使被编辑检索源的收藏每用户提升8.4%–10.7%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为精排/召回模型提供免梯度、免重训的权重直接编辑与业务目标调控范式，且有线上A/B支撑；但编辑高度模型特异、离线到线上存在衰减，需自建评估与验证协议。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B显示面向收藏目标的三个编辑臂使被编辑检索源的每用户收藏提升8.4%–10.7%，但长点击和商品占比下降，且排序器会抬高被编辑源导致挤占其他召回源曝光。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

explanation.problem: 用户目标会随场景变化，而平台固定的推荐目标未必跟得上，用户缺少随时改写推荐方向的手段。
explanation.method: 系统在每轮交互中接收用户当前的自然语言请求和此前的浏览记录，由一个语言模型控制器结合持久保存的用户事实、偏好与当前目标做判断。控制器可选择去检索新内容、对候选排序生成推荐列表，或更新用户状态记录，检索结果和后续浏览又反过来修正判断，如此循环。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴到电商推荐：把用户显式搜索词与行为序列写入会话级意图记忆，由控制器决定是否触发补充召回并驱动重排，用共享历史回放做离线对比。
explanation.caveat: 全部实验基于模拟用户轨迹和模型裁判打分，无真实线上A/B或人工标注验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 智能体瀑布：注意力经济中重获用户控制的意图驱动信息发现框架
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出由语言模型控制器维护持久用户状态、协调内容获取、排序与状态更新的意图驱动推荐框架，并构建含模拟交互轨迹的数据集与共享历史回放评测协议。在该数据集上盲评票数较最强基线ClawRec相对提升16.1%，但实验全部基于模拟用户与模型裁判，无真实线上验证。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 其“显式请求+浏览行为推断当前目标并写入持久记忆”的思路可迁移到生成式重排与意图理解，但证据仅来自模拟轨迹和模型裁判，需真实流量验证。

evidence.finding: 在自建数据集上，完整方法DCG@5为7.86、盲评票419.58，较ClawRec的361.33相对提升16.1%，但该结论来自模拟轨迹与模型裁判，非线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. First, the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) module enables an Interaction Agent and a Semantic Agent to analyze interaction signals and content-level semantic signals from complementary perspectives, generating diverse recommendation judgments through structured debate. Second, the Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (EG-RAR) module grounds the Semantic Agent's reasoning in item-level evidence and refines candidate scores by assessing how well the evidence supports the corresponding semantic claims. Third, the Judge-based Ranking Calibration (JRC) module leverages debate-derived reliability cues to adaptively calibrate interaction-based and semantic ranking results for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that MADRec consistently outperforms competitive baselines and enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.

explanation.problem: 多智能体协作推荐时，前一个智能体的错误判断会被后续智能体直接沿用，最终把排序带偏。
explanation.method: 先用冻结的序列模型召回每个用户的候选集；再让看交互历史的智能体和看内容语义的智能体多轮互评、互相质疑并各自重排；语义侧为每个候选生成事实主张，从条目资料中检索证据，用独立校验器判断证据是否支持该主张并据此缩放语义分；最后由裁判智能体根据辩论过程估计两路可靠性权重，加权融合出最终排序。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴到电商生成式重排：让行为序列智能体与商品内容智能体互评，并用商品标题/属性证据校验语义理由后再融合打分。
explanation.caveat: 仅三个公开数据集、每集2000测试用户的离线评测，无线上A/B，且辩论轮数与候选集规模只在单一数据集上做敏感性分析。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: MADRec：面向推荐的可信多智能体推理与证据支撑辩论
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出交互智能体与语义智能体多轮互评辩论、用条目级证据校验语义主张并据此调分、再由裁判智能体按可靠性加权融合的两阶段重排框架。在三个数据集上Recall@10与NDCG@10优于对比基线，并通过受控扰动显示中间排序错误传递率更低。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 多智能体辩论加证据校验抑制中间推理错误传播的思路，可迁移到生成式重排的可信度校准；但仅离线小样本评测、无线上A/B，且LLM多轮推理延迟成本高。

evidence.finding: 表2显示MADRec在三个数据集上Recall@10与NDCG@10均超过SASRec、MACF、TALLRec等基线，相对最强非MADRec基线提升约10%–33%，但均为离线留一法评测、每集仅2000采样用户。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.

explanation.problem: 对话推荐里用户需求常超出商品目录字段，且会反复增删改，用大模型每轮重读全部对话又慢又贵，还看不出商品满足了哪条需求。
explanation.method: 先把消息切成分句，用向量检索从目录字段值中找候选，再用一次类型化决策请求判断每句是想要、排除还是无关；无法映射到字段的需求保留用户原话作为待验证特征。然后对每个候选逐条需求问“支持、矛盾、证据不足”三选一，取支持概率减矛盾概率作为证据分；另有一个整体判断问题。排序时先按品类、地点、价格等硬条件分层，层内把整体分与需求证据均值等权相加。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴其“硬条件分层+需求级证据+整体判断”的无生成排序结构，用于电商搜索/推荐的精排或对话式导购，把用户原话转成可核验的需求项并保留证据展示；但需自建字段词表与撤回识别，不能直接照搬其闭世界标注。
explanation.caveat: 实验基于合成请求与合成对话、闭世界属性标注，撤回识别率仅19%–27%，产品搜索场景明显落后于LLM排序器。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: Needwise：基于需求级类型化决策的无生成对话推荐
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 用类型化决策模型（对固定选项输出概率、不生成文本）把每轮消息映射到目录字段、保留无法映射的用户原话，并按硬性条件分层、结合整体判断与需求级证据排序；在Google Local上nDCG@10为0.383，显著高于GPT-6 Sol的0.343，在Yelp上与最强LLM排序器无显著差异，但撤回需求识别率仅19%–27%。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 展示了用低成本类型化决策替代LLM逐轮重读对话的可行路径，但撤回识别弱、硬谓词易错，且实验为合成对话与闭世界标注。

evidence.finding: 单请求实验中Needwise-HF在Google Local上nDCG@10为0.383，显著高于GPT-6 Sol的0.343，在Yelp上与最强基线无显著差异；这是离线重排实验，非线上A/B。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Sequential recommender systems aim to predict a user's next interaction by modeling temporal dependencies in historical behavior sequences. To capture such dependencies, recent approaches increasingly rely on attention-based architectures, particularly transformers. While effective at modeling long-range sequential patterns, these models apply a fixed computation depth to all interaction items, treating them as equally complex. However, user behavior is inherently heterogeneous, with many interactions following simple repetitive patterns, whereas others require modeling higher-order dependencies. This mismatch leads to inefficient utilization of model capacity and unnecessary computational overhead, particularly in deep transformer-based architectures. To address this issue, we propose MoR4Rec, a sequential recommendation framework based on a Mixture-of-Recursion paradigm, which enables item-wise adaptive computation through a shared transformer backbone. A learned routing mechanism dynamically assigns each item to an appropriate recursion depth, allocating deeper computation to complex interactions while processing simpler patterns more efficiently. To improve computational efficiency, we develop a cascade-based strategy with key-value sharing across recursion steps. We further introduce a gated attention mechanism that adaptively regulates contextual information during recursive sequence modeling. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show that MoR4Rec consistently outperforms strong transformer-based baselines, achieving average gains of 2.28% in Recall@5, 2.50% in NDCG@5, and 2.0% in MRR@5 over the strongest baseline. The improvements remain consistent across top-10 and top-20 recommendation cutoffs, while comparisons with vanilla transformers demonstrate the computational efficiency of adaptive recursive processing.

explanation.problem: 用户行为序列里有的交互很简单、有的很复杂，但现有Transformer对所有交互都用同样多的层数计算，浪费算力。
explanation.method: 先把物品序列编码并过一层输入Transformer，再由一个线性路由器给每个位置打分，决定它要经过共享递归块几次；每轮只让需要更深计算的物品继续参与，并复用上一轮缓存的键值以减少重复计算，最后经输出层做下一物品预测，训练时加负载均衡损失防止所有物品都走同一深度。
explanation.application: 推测可把逐位置自适应深度用于精排长行为序列，对近期或意图切换位置多算、对习惯性交互少算，以省算力；需在自有数据上验证收益与路由稳定性。
explanation.caveat: 仅三个公开数据集离线实验，无线上A/B，效率对比只与同层数普通Transformer比较。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: MoR4Rec：面向序列推荐的递归混合
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出MoR4Rec，用可学习路由器为序列中每个物品分配不同递归深度，共享Transformer主干并跨递归步复用键值，在三个公开基准上平均超过最强基线约2.28% Recall@5、2.50% NDCG@5、2.0% MRR@5。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 逐物品自适应计算深度对精排序列建模有迁移价值，但仅在三个公开数据集离线验证，无线上A/B。

evidence.finding: 表2显示MoR4Rec在三个数据集各截断指标上多数优于十个基线，但Industrial & Scientific上相对最佳基线的提升幅度很小（如Recall@5仅0.3125%）。

institutions: National Institute of Technology Warangal, India

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that MKGE consistently outperforms collaborative, knowledge-graph, multimodal, and recent LLM/MLLM-based recommenders across all six reported metrics. Controlled studies further demonstrate the importance of canonical concept identities and personalized user-concept correspondence, with especially pronounced gains over removing or rewiring the user graph for low-activity users. These results establish canonical multimodal concepts as effective units for preference modeling and transfer. Code, constructed knowledge graphs, and prompts are available at https://github.com/Garden1a-X/MKGE.

explanation.problem: 用户点了一个商品，系统只能把整件商品当作正反馈，无法知道用户到底喜欢其中哪个可复用的视觉或主题因素。
explanation.method: 先用多模态大模型从抽样商品的图片和标题里发现候选概念，再聚类合并同义说法形成规范概念词表，并约束全量商品只能从该词表打标。然后把每个用户按时间分桶的历史映射到同一批概念上，选出短期和长期支持的概念集合。最后构建用户、商品、概念异构图，用两路图注意力分别学直接协同关系和概念中介关系，融合后排序。
explanation.application: 推测可借鉴其“概念词表+用户-概念边”的显式偏好接口，在电商精排中作为多模态兴趣特征与ID类协同特征并联，并重点验证低活跃用户分层收益。
explanation.caveat: 证据全部来自三个公开数据集的离线评测，无线上A/B，概念质量依赖离线大模型抽取。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 将用户偏好锚定在共享多模态概念上的推荐
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出MKGE，用多模态大模型从商品图像和标题中归纳出规范化的多模态概念词表，把用户历史映射到同一批概念上，再在用户-商品-概念异构图上学直接协同与概念中介双路径推荐。在三个公开数据集六个指标上均优于协同、知识图谱、多模态及近期大模型基线，消融显示用户-概念对应关系最关键，低活跃用户收益最大。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 把多模态语义变成可跨商品复用的显式偏好坐标，对精排价值建模和冷启动/低活用户有直接借鉴价值；但仅在公开数据集离线评测，无线上A/B，且概念构建依赖离线大模型。

evidence.finding: 该页的grounding对照实验显示，完整用户-概念锚定在ML-1M和Video Games上均优于频次、IDF和度保持重连三种对照，且低活跃用户相对去掉用户图的提升最大（24.74%），属于离线受控实验而非线上A/B。

institutions: 复旦大学数据科学学院

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title: Beyond Knowledge Transfer: How User Overlap Shapes Diversity in Cross-Domain Recommendation
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.abstract: A common paradigm in cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers knowledge through users shared by source and target domains. Although this overlap bridge is effective in improving accuracy, its effect on diversity remains unclear. We identify two bottlenecks: the bridge can be too narrow when overlapping users cover limited target-domain tastes, and too loud when shared signals dominate the sparse personal evidence of non-overlapping users. To address both, we propose DivCDR, a model-agnostic Push--Pull framework. Pull constructs confidence-gated virtual positives for overlapping users and optimizes their exposure-entropy gain, broadening the preferences carried by the bridge. Push uses overlap-density-guided negative sampling to move non-overlapping users away from overlap-dense regions. Experiments on three datasets and five representative CDR backbones show that DivCDR improves recommendation diversity while preserving or improving accuracy in most settings.

explanation.problem: 跨域推荐借重叠用户迁移知识时，常让推荐更同质、多样性不升反降，论文要弄清原因并缓解。
explanation.method: 先分析两种失效：重叠用户曝光过窄、非重叠用户被重叠信号淹没。对重叠用户，沿个性化方向微调正样本，用置信度控制幅度，并直接最大化曝光熵增益；对非重叠用户，估计其与重叠用户曝光的相似度，沿降低该相似度的方向采样负样本，相似度越高采样越尖锐。两者只改训练目标，不改骨干结构。
explanation.application: 推测可把推拉损失作为插件加到电商跨域精排或召回训练中，按用户是否跨域重叠分组施加不同干预，并以曝光熵、覆盖率和NDCG共同评估。
explanation.caveat: 证据仅来自三个公开数据集的离线实验，无线上A/B或用户留存验证。

52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.title_zh: 超越知识迁移：用户重叠如何塑造跨域推荐中的多样性
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.summary: 提出模型无关的推拉框架DivCDR：对重叠用户构造置信门控虚拟正样本以扩大曝光熵，对非重叠用户按重叠密度引导负采样以逃离同质区域。在三个数据集和五个跨域骨干上多数设置提升多样性且保持或提升准确率。
52613b5bcbddfb2e88fa3bf524a5bfbf1686a9b1.reason: 为跨域迁移中的多样性退化提供可插拔的推拉干预，但仅离线评测、无线上验证。

evidence.finding: 表2显示在三个数据集、五个骨干上多数设置多样性指标提升且准确率保持或提升，但均为离线评测，无线上A/B。
